sentences.text: 1 Page No.# 2/2 This is an application filed under section 439 Cr.P.C., seeking bail by the petitioner Khargeswar Mushahary @ Tiklu @ Khargeswar Mushahari, in connection with Basistha PS Case No.56/2023 under sections 448/376/511 IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the accused petitioner has been detained in custody since 03.02.2023.
Charge sheet has not yet been submitted.
The accused has completed the mandatory period of 90 days in jail hajot and accordingly the accused is entitled for default bail.
Public Prosecutor has also made no objection if the accused is released on bail.

Considering the period of detention, the accused be released on bail in connection with Basistha PS Case No.56/2023 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (M), Guwahati.
The bail application stands disposed of.
